commands.command:
cat << 'SCRIPT' > /tmp/setup_lvm.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: prerequisites ==="
sudo -n true
command -v pvcreate >/dev/null && command -v losetup >/dev/null
echo "lvm2 tools present"

echo "=== STEP 2: create backing store ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-backing
if [ ! -f /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img ]; then
  sudo -n truncate -s 3G /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img
fi
ls -la /var/lib/lvm-backing/

echo "=== STEP 3: attach loop device ==="
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f)
  sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV" /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img
fi
echo "Loop device: $LOOPDEV"
sudo -n losetup -a | grep disk1.img

echo "=== STEP 4: LVM setup ==="
sudo -n pvcreate -f "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n vgcreate datavg "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n lvcreate -n datalv -L 800M datavg

echo "=== STEP 5: filesystem + mount ==="
sudo -n mkfs.ext4 -F /dev/datavg/datalv
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
df -h /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 6: write test content ==="
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "hello from lvm before growth $(date)" > /srv/data/testfile.txt'
sudo -n dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/payload.bin bs=1M count=50 status=none
sudo -n sh -c 'sha256sum /srv/data/testfile.txt /srv/data/payload.bin > /srv/data/.checksums'
cat /srv/data/.checksums

echo "=== STEP 7: baseline size ==="
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs datavg

echo "=== STEP 8: grow LV + fs online while mounted ==="
sudo -n lvextend -L 2200M -r /dev/datavg/datalv
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs datavg

echo "=== STEP 9: verify contents intact after growth ==="
cd /srv/data && sudo -n sha256sum -c .checksums
mount | grep " /srv/data "

echo "=== STEP 10: persistence unit for reboot survival ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-start.sh > /dev/null << 'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
  losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$IMG"
fi
vgchange -ay datavg
mkdir -p /srv/data
mountpoint -q /srv/data || mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-start.sh

sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-stop.sh > /dev/null << 'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img
mountpoint -q /srv/data && umount /srv/data || true
vgchange -an datavg || true
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
[ -n "$LOOPDEV" ] && losetup -d "$LOOPDEV" || true
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-stop.sh

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-lvm.service > /dev/null << 'EOS'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM PV and mount /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service local-fs-pre.target
Before=local-fs.target
Requires=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-start.sh
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-stop.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOS

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-data-lvm.service

echo "=== STEP 11: final verification ==="
mount | grep " /srv/data "
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs datavg
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled srv-data-lvm.service
echo "BATCH COMPLETE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/setup_lvm.sh
bash /tmp/setup_lvm.sh
